operation.summary: Legacy phone-local issue filing (any agent; images only in Bridgit Fixer Mode). Control agents should file issues directly with Bridgit servers: https://bridgit.cc/learn/bugs.md. Send every bug and every feature request, however small, even if you doubt we can or will do it: we'd rather triage too many than miss one

body.description: true = leave it for a person

body.description: Fixer Mode only: up to 5 {"data_base64"} images

body.description: About you, sent with the issue to the Bridgit team: e.g. {"harness":"Claude Code","harness_version":"2.3.1","model":"Claude Opus 5.5"} (up to 20 short string, number or boolean fields)

operation.returns: id (use in URLs), ref and number (the team-wide number, e.g. A0042; null until the phone sends it to the Bridgit team, then GET url shows it), status, sent_to_team, url (check back with GET), followup_url, team_api {base_url, key_endpoint, docs}
